# Observed diagnostics and isolated delivery gates

Diagnostics sample actual host lifecycle boundaries, not guessed successful operations. Startup is process start to the first renderer document load. Desktop frames are visible document animation callback intervals, not GPU render time. Model workflow timings are grouped by Agent turn or one-shot completion; complete turns include tools/network. Samples are bounded to 200 per metric; missing sample windows have no percentiles, never synthetic zero latency. Error/abort workflows are counted without retaining their messages.

Only Main creates the sampler and supplies a WebContents reference. A renderer cannot nominate a URL, file or arbitrary evaluation script. Sampling uses a fixed short requestAnimationFrame script, userGesture=false, no input/focus. Hidden documents return no frames, malformed/bounded results are discarded and counted, and destroyed windows release listeners/timers. Completed and failed calls preserve return/throw semantics. Packaged identity comes only from the bounded build manifest, with a hash clearly labeled as manifest hash.

Acceptance: test missing/hidden/malformed frames, one startup sample across reloads, no pointer/focus methods, concurrent session+turn matching, duplicate and late events, error/abort outcomes, exact rethrow, bounded buffers and output sanitization. Independently measure empty, flora and dense fixed worlds in headless Chromium with no input. Record CPU/GPU/browser, viewport, load time, window duration, sample counts, scoped memory and prior reference thresholds. Treat measurements as local reference data, not visible Electron performance or clean-OS evidence.

The isolated installer CI entry must refuse local/self-hosted execution before mutation. Dry-run/readiness mode is read-only. Actual ephemeral CI should exercise silent install, upgrade snapshot and original-file preservation on locked-profile failure, then uninstall with synthetic profile retention. Existing NSIS backup failure must return nonzero without a dialog in silent mode. Without an isolated runner, report those execution scenarios unverified; do not install on the developer machine to complete a checkbox.
